svg.title: Mica: reads untrusted bytes, never guesses. Pure-Crystal parsing for Amber.
svg.desc: Mica, the Amber crew's reader, at a lectern in a sunlit library with glowing byte tiles rising from her book. Beside her, a brass loupe sweeps once across the request line GET /posts/2026-11-21/mica HTTP/1.1 and lights up the date that the pattern \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} matches.
